User_Story: As a host operator, I need readiness checks so unsupported controls stay disabled.
Acceptance_Criteria_Given_When_Then: Given unsupported or inaccessible interfaces, when readiness runs, then affected features are reported unavailable and disabled.

User_Story: As AIOS, I need sourced CPU, RAM, I/O, pressure and ordered samples.
Acceptance_Criteria_Given_When_Then: Given supported sources, when a sample is emitted, then source/unit/scope and UTC/monotonic ordering are present; unapproved eBPF stays off.

User_Story: As AIOS, I need process identity and data-quality checks so bad evidence cannot drive actions.
Acceptance_Criteria_Given_When_Then: Given stale data, reset counters or PID reuse, when validated, then dependent values are rejected and no action is authorized.

User_Story: As an operator, I need bounded telemetry retention and read-only access.
Acceptance_Criteria_Given_When_Then: Given retention limits, when storage grows, then DB/WAL remain bounded and dashboard queries cannot actuate.

User_Story: As a model integrator, I need a generic provenance-bound inference boundary without OS privilege.
Acceptance_Criteria_Given_When_Then: Given an approved window, when inference returns, then provenance is retained and inference cannot call actuator or write OS controls.

User_Story: As an operator, I need a reasoned LEAVE/propose/deny decision per process/window.
Acceptance_Criteria_Given_When_Then: Given a proposal, when policy evaluates it, then the result records its reason and all admission gates.

User_Story: As a safety reviewer, I need OBSERVE_ONLY defaults and independent CPU/RAM/I/O gates.
Acceptance_Criteria_Given_When_Then: Given restart, invalid config or unsupported control, when admission runs, then no forbidden or unauthorized write occurs.

User_Story: As the actuator, I need authenticated IPC and immediate identity revalidation.
Acceptance_Criteria_Given_When_Then: Given an untrusted peer or changed target, when a request arrives, then it is rejected before any OS write.

User_Story: As an operator, I need bounded CPU control with readback and guarded restoration.
Acceptance_Criteria_Given_When_Then: Given an admitted request, when cpu.weight changes, then prior/new values and verification are recorded; restoration is identity-checked.

User_Story: As an operator, I need RAM control restricted to memory.high.
Acceptance_Criteria_Given_When_Then: Given an admitted request, when memory.high is changed, then it is bounded/read back and memory.max/process termination never occurs.

User_Story: As an operator, I need device-aware I/O control and same-device rollback.
Acceptance_Criteria_Given_When_Then: Given unsupported or changed device identity, when write/rollback is checked, then no mismatched device control is written.

User_Story: As a safety reviewer, I need an independent watchdog and fail-closed recovery.
Acceptance_Criteria_Given_When_Then: Given stale inputs or missed heartbeat, when watchdog triggers, then writes stop and only verified prior values are restored.

User_Story: As a security reviewer, I need correlated tamper-evident audit history.
Acceptance_Criteria_Given_When_Then: Given a chain break, when verification runs, then integrity failure is visible and active control is disabled.

User_Story: As a sysadmin/SRE, I need a clear read-only dashboard with no control path.
Acceptance_Criteria_Given_When_Then: Given dashboard status, when viewed, then outcomes and data quality are distinct and no write/approval action is possible.

User_Story: As a privacy reviewer, I need least privilege and sensitive fields omitted by default.
Acceptance_Criteria_Given_When_Then: Given default projections, when host/process data is shown, then opaque aliases are used and command lines, environment, users, paths and payloads are omitted.

User_Story: As an evaluator, I need resource cost and foreground impact measures for threshold setting.
Acceptance_Criteria_Given_When_Then: Given an evaluation run, when thresholds are proposed, then CPU/RSS/storage/freshness/latency/impact evidence is recorded first.

User_Story: As a maintainer, I need requirement-level verification and honest implementation status.
Acceptance_Criteria_Given_When_Then: Given a release review, when a requirement is checked, then planned verification, implementation and collected evidence are distinguished.

User_Story: As a research team, I need demand hypotheses separated from technical evidence.
Acceptance_Criteria_Given_When_Then: Given a technical reference, when benefit/need is stated, then it is not represented as participant evidence or validated demand.

User_Story: As an operator, I need optional CPU placement/quotas excluded from safety-critical services.
Acceptance_Criteria_Given_When_Then: Given a reviewed profile, when optional affinity/quota is used, then effective mask is checked and watchdog/policy/actuator are not tightly capped.
